data.cleaned_text: [7:47p.m.] #Lekki #TrafficUpdate Traffic is good in and out of Admiralty Way, likewise in and out of Freedom Way. Though a bit slow on the Lekki-Ikoyi link bridge due to high influx, our men are on hand in strategic places to ensure smooth traffic. Admiralty Roundabout inward Road 12, Fam City, Adidas Store, Evercare Hospital, Lekki Peninsula gate to Lekki Roundabout is good.
